posts.title: Our new electrical workshop opens
posts.excerpt: Twenty-four live test panels and a solar roof rig for the second-year students.
posts.content:
This term our electrical students moved into a new workshop with twenty-four live test panels, an EV charger bay and a small solar roof rig on the mezzanine.

The workshop was planned with three partner employers, who will use it for their own apprentices one evening a week.

posts.title: Second-year carpenters build a timber frame
posts.excerpt: A full-size frame for a garden classroom, from drawings to the last joint.
posts.content:
Our second-year carpentry students spent six weeks building the timber frame of a garden classroom for a primary school in Kita Ward.

Every joint was cut by hand in the building hall, then the frame was assembled on site in two days with a crane from one of our partner employers.

posts.title: Employer evening in March
posts.excerpt: Meet our students and plan next year’s placements and apprenticeships.
posts.content:
Every March we invite our partner employers to meet second-year students, see their work in the workshops and plan placements for the next year.

Last year 64 employers came and offered 180 placements and 52 apprenticeships. Places at the evening are free; please book.
